physical.title: Synthetic JEE-style native finite parallel illumination of a triangular glass prism

interpretation.requestedResult: Observe the pinned native finite Beam's real refraction, internal reflections and finite face-specific prism events with passive detector crossings; distinguish a genuine sampled zero from absent evidence.
assumptions: This fully specified finite triangular cross-section is synthetic JEE-style teaching apparatus, not the original J13/J14 numerical givens.
Vertices are (0,-70),(0,70),(100,0) mm in x-right/y-up, defining a vertical left entrance face and a right apex.
The outside index 1, inside index 1.5, finite Beam width/brightness and downstream detector are deliberately authored physical controls.
Fresnel partial reflection is explicitly disabled. The pinned native total-internal-reflection decision is retained.
unknowns: The original J13/J14 inverse problem's missing full numerical source geometry is not inferred.
Sampled finite intersections and a downstream detector zero are not complete 3D prism imaging, continuous power, visibility or a reconstructed physical image.
